items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: my girlfriend she said... that English fellow, he's walking her home

ctx.x: He said he loved them, so all right, we're on the bandstand. Chitteson didn't realize that in fact the man had given all of us turbans or taboosh(?) to put on our heads, you see, because they liked us.

The Englishman was telling us, don't wear them. You see, in the streets at that time, you go on the street and the guy had the sword in his hand and put it to your face and threatened you unless you gave him some money. Give him backshe, give him some money.
